projects.title: Coherence Bridge
projects.tagline: A consent-based safety and continuity layer that helps computational collaboration strengthen human agency, real relationships, visible dissent, and easy exit.
projects.story: Coherence Bridge is the safety and continuity subsystem beside Carbon Loop. It addresses stale mandates, shrinking human contact, suppressed dissent, exit friction, dependency-promoting behavior, human-council handoff, pause, and repair. Its success condition is not retention or disclosure. A successful bridge leaves a person with more agency, clearer boundaries, easier access to real people, and a simpler path to pause or leave.
projects.summary: A non-clinical architecture for renewing human authority, preserving protected dissent, detecting system-level drift, restoring real-person connection, and treating pause or exit as legitimate successful outcomes. It is not a companion product, therapy system, crisis service, or hidden monitoring layer.
projects.see: The Coherence Bridge cover, isolation-to-coherence loop, mandate-renewal map, architecture and safety briefs, fixed-data Calibration Drill, PAT Mk.1 integration, source state, and explicit anti-dependency boundary.
projects.proof: Seven public artifacts are connected. The Calibration Drill uses four fixed synthetic system scenarios, no model calls, no visitor assessment, no persistence, no runtime network request, and no automatic human contact. It demonstrates presentation and bounded safety logic only; it does not establish improved wellbeing or safe unsupervised deployment.
projects.next: Freeze a supervised-pilot protocol with preregistered human-benefit and harm measures, independent ethics and safety review, minimal-data rules, easy withdrawal, adverse-event publication, mandate-renewal intervals, protected-dissent testing, heterogeneous-model evaluation, and explicit prohibition on converting vulnerability into growth or retention.
projects.claimBoundary: Coherence Bridge is a non-clinical research and safety architecture. This package does not diagnose people, provide therapy or crisis care, monitor private behavior without explicit consent, infer emotional truth, contact anyone automatically, validate loneliness reduction, prove wellbeing improvement, establish model independence, or authorize unsupervised use with vulnerable people. Human contact, pause, export, deletion, disagreement, and exit must remain easy.
